newsitem.title: USA: Kerr debt holders sell $50.9 mln of debt.
newsitem.headline: Kerr debt holders sell $50.9 mln of debt.

text.p: Kerr Group Inc said Tuesday that holders of $50.9 million of its existing unsecured debt have sold the debt.

Kerr said the new owners have indicated that they do not intend to pursue a previously announced restructuring of the debt, but instead prefer a restructuring that would involve the exchange of debt for equity in Kerr.

Kerr said the new owners have agreed to extend waivers of certain financial covenants and the maturity of a portion of the debt through December 31 to give the company time to evaluate restructuring terms.

The previously announced restructuring called for a portion of the debt to be repaid with proceeds of a new secured credit facility from CIT Gruop/Business Credit Inc, and the balance of which was to have been converted into preferred stock and subordinated debt.
